Learning to explore

Start with the offering that matches your role. Faculty orientation, academic leader orientation and supervisor onboarding each have different audiences.

Program

Faculty Affairs

New Faculty Orientation (NFO)

Connect new faculty with university culture, colleagues and resources.

Who it serves: Faculty who joined during the previous academic year.

Source reviewed 2026-09-16 · Provider website

Program

Faculty Affairs

New Academic Leader Orientation (NALO)

Learn the responsibilities and university context of a new academic leadership appointment.

Who it serves: New provost, vice president, dean or department head titles; others with approval.

Source reviewed 2026-09-16 · Provider website

Course

HROE Organizational Development

New Supervisor Bootcamp

Build a foundation in supervisor responsibilities, university processes and campus resources.

Who it serves: New and newly promoted supervisors have priority; existing supervisors may join a waitlist.

Source reviewed 2026-09-16 · Provider website

About this hub

A private design concept bringing Texas A&M leadership learning into one place. Providers set eligibility, selection criteria, fees and session dates. Audience filters help you explore; check the details before enrolling.
